headline: Reviewers say new Googlebooks laptops have good hardware but unready software
summary: Reviews of the new Googlebooks laptops from Dell, Lenovo, and HP praised the hardware but found the Android-based OS still feels like 'Android on a PC' and needs more polish. One review also called the launch poorly timed, comparing it to Valve's Steam Machine and noting extremely limited phone support at launch.

claims.statement: Reviewers tested Googlebooks laptops from Dell, Lenovo, and HP, finding solid hardware but an OS not yet ready.

sources.quote: Googlebooks from Dell, Lenovo, and HP tested: Nice hardware, but the OS isn't ready yet
Googlebook OS needs a lot of love to feel like something other than Android on a PC.

claims.statement: Another review said that despite being laptops, the Googlebook experience still feels like Android and needs more work from Google.

sources.quote: Googlebook review: Android on a laptop is still Android
Android laptops are here, but Google has a lot of work ahead to make them good.

claims.statement: A review said the Googlebooks launch was poorly timed, comparing it to Valve's Steam Machine, and noted extremely limited phone support at launch.
